title: Exception on press back button on Moto C
body:
### Issue description
I see issue on Moto C device. When i go out from activity with player i get exception. 

### Reproduction steps
You can easy reproduce it with demo from this repository. 

- Simple start demo (https://github.com/google/ExoPlayer/tree/release-v2/demos/main)
- start any video
- press back button

### Version of ExoPlayer being used
I see this error on 2.7.*, 2.8.0, 2.8.1 versions

### Device(s) and version(s) of Android being used
Moto C (Android 7.0)
